newsitem.title: MEXICO: FOCUS - Mexico bellwether Cetes rate eases.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Mexico bellwether Cetes rate eases.

text.p: Mexico's bellwether one-month treasury bill rate fell sharply at the primary auction on Tuesday, benefiting from a stable peso and expectations of declining inflation, analysts said.
The rate on the one-month Cetes fell 147 basis points to 24.24 percent. A survey by Reuters of dealers showed expectations of a decline of 93 basis points on the one-month paper.
Analysts said good foreign demand has helped push Cetes rates down recently.
"We have seen a stable peso, which is helping by not putting pressure on rates," said one analyst.

Although demand fell slightly this week to 9.63 billion pesos, compared to 10.15 billion last week, analysts said continued strong demand is helped by a perception that the peso will remain stable throughout at least the first quarter.
Foreign investors were seen buying Mexican securities earlier in the day ahead of the expected fall in Cetes rates.
Investors who last year bet on peso-denominated instruments have seen good returns.
